eyebrow: Full worked example at theta = pi/3
code:
f(theta) = cos(theta)

f(theta + pi/2) = cos(5pi/6) = -0.8660
f(theta - pi/2) = cos(-pi/6) =  0.8660

df/dtheta = (-0.8660 - 0.8660) / 2
          = -0.8660
caption: Matches the calculus derivative -sin(pi/3) ≈ -0.8660 exactly.
